standalone.form_description: Connect to an SFTP endpoint that is separate from a saved SSH host.
standalone.usage_notice: This is an independent SFTP endpoint. For ordinary file transfer, use SFTP from “SSH Host”. Use this only when the SFTP port or credentials differ.
standalone.mode_local_remote_hint: Authenticate one remote host and transfer files between it and this device.
standalone.mode_remote_remote_hint: Authenticate two independent remote hosts and transfer files directly between them.
standalone.options_hint: Choose the initial remote directory and connection timeout.
standalone.initial_path_hint: Leave blank to open the server's default home directory.
standalone.save_failed: Failed to save independent SFTP connection
standalone.missing_credentials: The saved SFTP credentials are unavailable
standalone.route_host_key_unavailable: The SFTP route host-key endpoint is unavailable

errors.connection_unavailable: The remote connection is unavailable. Reconnect and try again.

archive.create_hint: Enter an absolute remote archive path. The extension selects tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar.zst, zip or 7z. Existing archives are not replaced.
archive.extract_hint: Enter an absolute remote destination directory. Leave the current directory to extract here. Existing files are not overwritten. Only extract trusted archives.
archive.invalid: Invalid remote archive destination or unsupported format
archive.busy: An archive task is already running
archive.failed: Remote archive task failed (check permissions, conflicts or tool compatibility). Partial output may remain.
